caption:
Say these 3 things before you sleep 😴 

#loveyourself #healthybodyhealthymind #mindfulness #wellnessjourney
transcript: Say to yourself these three things before sleep and watch how your anxiety and stress begin to disappear. Tonight, before your eyes close, do not try to fix your life. Do not replay the day. Simply return to the body. First, say to yourself, nothing is required of me right now. The day is complete. Effort can rest. Second, say, I am safe in this moment. The mind travels to tomorrow, but the body lives only here, and here there is no danger. Third, say slowly, I allow my body to let go. Let the shoulders soften. Let the jaw release. Let the breath fall back into its natural rhythm. Sleep is not something you force. It is something you allow. And when the body feels permission, the mind follows. If this practice helped you, return to it each night. Stillness grows through repetition. And if you wish to go deeper, you will find gentle guidance inside my e-book, The Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile. Walk slowly. Rest deeply.
